name: Kick
description: Kick is a public live‑streaming platform for watching and broadcasting content across gaming, IRL, music, sports, and more, featuring real‑time chat, clips, and channel subscriptions. It emphasizes creator-friendly monetization with a 95/5 subscription revenue split and is accessible on web and mobile apps.

events.d: Find Kick user profiles by one or more user IDs.
Retrieve channels for the current account or by broadcaster user IDs or channel slugs.
